translation: Flavor sour, neutral, non-toxic. It mainly treats damage to the center with scant qi, yin withering [陰消] in men, loss of urine in the aged, supplements the center and continues the severed, fills the bone marrow, removes pain of the brain and pain of the lower back and spine, obstruction of menstruation in women, blood binding, boosts essence, benefits yin qi, and stops graying of the hair. It grows in Henei and Linqu.
